edges.mechanism: NSAIDs can reduce renal lithium clearance and increase serum lithium/toxicity risk.
edges.evidence: Prescription lithium labeling warns of interaction; applies to therapeutic lithium exposure.

edges.mechanism: No specific interaction established; renal impairment/dehydration can independently alter lithium safety and requires clinical monitoring.
edges.evidence: Lithium label advises monitoring renal function and hydration; no direct trial of this pair identified.
